TRC composite materials can be considered as an alternative to traditional FRP composite materials to strengthen masonry walls under horizontal cyclic loads.

the study of the behaviour of masonry structures subjected to cyclic in plane loads.

TRC composites are more efficient than FRP composites for strengthening masonry walls under in plane cyclic solicitations.
TRC composites are more efficient than FRP composites in the case of walls reinforced with vertical composite sheets.

the TRC composite material has the highest performance among the tested composites, in terms of load capacity, stiffness degradation, and energy dissipation capacity, while the FRP composite material has the lowest performance.
